name: gatelogic
description: Every decision the door gate makes: the wiring table as a compile-time struct, the lock's two polarity questions composed in one place, scanner line assembly, the repeat-scan debounce, the online-first flow and its roster fallback, the release window and its hard cap, and the LED patterns. Knows about a door and nothing else, which is why it is not in shared/lib. No Arduino headers, no heap; compiles for Xtensa and host.
keywords: gate, door, lock, relay, scanner, embedded
